podcast-joerogan-0xMBjMlDY9M:
Guitarist Marcus King joins Joe Rogan for episode 2499. King leads a band steeped in blues, soul, and southern rock. His playing earned praise while he was still a teen.

Rogan explores the roots of King's sound and his family of musicians. They talk about life on the road and the weight of grief in songs. King shares how faith and music carry him. The episode is warm and soulful. Guitar lovers get a young master talking craft, loss, and joy in one sitting. Soul runs through each story that he tells.
uslaw-usc-t2-s179m:
Section 179m of Title 2 of the United States Code states the duties of the Librarian of Congress under the national film preservation law. It sits in the film preservation chapters of Title 2, and works alongside the National Film Preservation Board under section 179n. The version here is current through Public Law 119-134.

One duty is to continue the comprehensive national film preservation program for motion pictures set up under the National Film Preservation Act of 1992. The Librarian acts with other film archivists, teachers, and historians, with copyright owners and film industry figures, and with others in film preservation work. The program must coordinate activities so that the efforts of archivists, owners, and others in public and private life are effective and fit together. It must also build public awareness, as the text goes on to state.
